name: todo-app
description: Todo app: Next.js web, Express API, Prisma and PostgreSQL

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test && npm run db:check
